Info

Concrete implementation of REPL binary frame transmitter.

class scaralang.infrastructure.cli.repl.transmission.repl_frame_transmitter.ReplFrameTransmitter(*, endpoint: str = 'dry-run', dry_run: bool = True)[source]¶

Bases: object

Transmitter sending binary frames to hardware, emulator or dry-run buffer.
